thread:
Julie CSM: Hey team, quick request from SageWell — theyre getting ready for a public beta next week and are seeing high tail latency for users in Canada and Brazil. Customer asked if we can provision regional egress + priority routing for their account for a 72h window starting 2026-04-03T08:00Z. They also want a stable IP block for an upcoming webhook migration.
Alex Chang: Got it. Do we have the CIDR they want to use or are they asking for a customer-dedicated NAT? If they need stable inbound IPs we usually put them on the peered egress list or add a reserved EIP pool for Dedicated customers.
Julie CSM: They sent this: ``CIDR: 203.0.113.0/28 (customer-owned, will announce)`` and theyd like a routed path via our canada-edge and br-sao-edge regions. They are still on hosted tier but volume is spiky. Also flag: renewal in 6 weeks, CSM wants to avoid a bad first-week experience.
Maria Patel: If theyre on hosted we can do a temporary route policy + a rate-window bump. Well need an ops ticket with the CIDR, ASN if applicable, and exact start/end times. Also confirm whether they need persistent KV cache affinity (likely not for webhooks).
Tom Nguyen: I can take the peering/egress side. Will need the following to file infra change: ``customer_account: sagewell-prod`` ``cidr: 203.0.113.0/28`` ``regions: ca-central-1, sa-east-1`` ``start: 2026-04-03T08:00Z`` ``end: 2026-04-06T08:00Z``. Any SLA ask? This will be a best-effort priority policy unless they commit to Dedicated.
Julie CSM: They asked for "priority routing" but not SLA — happy with best-effort as long as we monitor and auto-fallback. Also asked that we capture feedback about longer-term regional failover as a product request (theyre worried about noisy neighbor effects).
ProvisionBot: Created INC-9876: "SageWell temporary regional egress + priority routing" assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-9876
Alex Chang: Tom — can you add an auto-revoke at end time and a follow-up check in 48h into the ticket? Also tag eng-sre to watch latency dashboards and set an alert threshold at p95 > 220ms for the two regions.
Tom Nguyen: Yep. Adding auto-revoke and a 48h health check. I'll also add a shortrun playbook: if p95>220ms -> rollback to global-route fallback and notify CSM.
Maria Patel: FYI, noted renewal risk — CSM to run a success check after 24h of go-live. Julie, can you schedule a 30-min sync with the customer during the first day? Might help capture feedback for the product team.
Julie CSM: Scheduled 2026-04-03T12:00Z. Invites sent to SageWell PM + infra lead. Thanks :thumbsup:
Tom Nguyen: Filed the infra change and peering request. INC-9876 updated with details, engineers start on 2026-04-02 22:00Z maintenance window to prep routes.
ProvisionBot: Reminder set — auto-revoke will execute at 2026-04-06T08:10Z unless ticket extended.
Alex Chang: One more ask — add a short note in the ticket capturing customers ask for a persistent IP pool option for hosted customers. Product has been collecting these requests.
Julie CSM: Done. I also put their feedback in the "regional-failover-requests" doc and linked it in the ticket.
ProvisionBot: INC-9876 -> status: in-progress -> assignees: eng-infra, eng-sre
Julie CSM: Great work everyone. Keep me posted in this thread and tag me if any rollback is needed.
